pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or adding size into an active drawdown; pyramiding is exclusively authorized only after a trade achieves a minimum of +$10.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory integration of an ATR-based volatility buffer to widen initial stop-losses beyond obvious micro-orderbook liquidity nodes.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position size upon hitting +$10.00 profit, and trail the remainder dynamically to capture the desired +$15.00 to +$30.00 asymmetric tail.
